entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Qaaf. (This is an individual letter of the Arabic alphabet; Allah and His Messenger know its exact meaning.) By the oath of the Glorious Qur'aan.
Rather, they were shocked that a warner came to them from amongst them, so the disbelievers said, 'This is something strange.'
'What! When we die and will be turned into dust, will we be raised again? This return is far (from our understanding).'
We know whatever the earth reduces from them (i.e. from their bodies in the grave), and with Us is a Book that records (everything).
Rather, they belied the truth (i.e. the Qur'aan) when it came to them, so they are now in an unstable state of confusion.
So, did they not see the sky above them; how We made it and adorned it, and there is no crack in it?
And (how) We have spread the earth, and placed (mountains as) anchors in it, and have grown all kinds of delightful pairs (of plants) in it?
An insight and an understanding, for every bondsman who returns (to the truth).
And We sent down blessed water from the sky, so We produced gardens therewith, and grain that is harvested.
And (made) tall date trees with ripe fruit piled over one another in layers.
As sustenance for the bondsmen, and with it (i.e. rainwater) We revived a dead city; this is how you are to emerge from the graves.
Before these, the people of Nooh had belied, and (so did) the dwellers of Rass (Rass is the name of a well) and Thamood.
And 'Aad, and Fir'awn (Pharaoh), and the compatriots of Loot.
And the Dwellers of the Woods, and the people of Tubba'; each one of them belied the Messengers, so My promised punishment proved true.
So! Were We exhausted by creating the first time? Rather, they are in doubt about being re-created.
And indeed, We have created man and We know what his baser-self whispers (to him); and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
When the two account-taking (angels) take (account) from him; one seated on the right and one on the left.
He does not utter a single word, except that there is a ready record-keeper (angel) seated next to him.
And the agony of death came with the truth; this is what you were fleeing from.
And the Trumpet was blown; this is the Day of the promised punishment.
And every soul came in such a manner that along with it is one (angel) who drives (it) and a witness.
'You were indeed neglectful of this, so We have removed the veil from you, your eyesight is therefore sharp this Day.'
And his accompanying angel said, 'This is (the record of your deeds) which is present with me.'
It will be ordered (to the two angels), 'Both of you throw every excessively ungrateful stubborn person into Hell.'
'The one who excessively forbids from virtue, the transgressor, the doubtful (regarding the matters of Islam).'
'The one who associated another god along with Allah, so both of you throw him into severe punishment.'
His accompanying devil said, 'Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel; yes, he himself was in far misguidance.'
He (Allah) will say, 'Do not dispute before Me, I had already warned you of the punishment.'
'With Me, the decree (of reward or punishment) does not change, and nor do I oppress the bondsmen.'
The Day when We will ask Hell, 'Are you filled up?' and it will answer, 'Is there some more?'
And Paradise will be brought close to the pious, which will not be far away from them.
(It will be said) this is (Paradise) what you are being promised; for everyone who repents, who guards (himself against sins).
Who fears the Most Gracious without seeing and came with a repenting heart.
It will be said to them, 'Enter Paradise in peace, this is the day of eternity.'
For them there is whatever they wish, and with Us there is even more than that.
How many generations did We destroy before them who were severe than them in seizing; so (when Our punishment came), they ran about in the cities (for refuge). Is there a place to escape?
Indeed, in this is advice for the one who has a heart, or listens attentively and pays attention.
And We have indeed created the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, in six days. And fatigue did not (even) approach Us.
So (O Beloved) be patient upon what they say, and while praising your Lord, glorify Him before the sun rises and before the sun sets.
And glorify Him during the night, and after (all) the Salahs.
And listen attentively on the Day when an announcer will proclaim from a nearby place.
The Day when they will hear the Scream with the truth; this is the Day to emerge from the graves.
Indeed, We give life and cause death, and towards Us is the return (of everyone).
On the Day when the earth will split open above them (whilst they are inside the graves), so they will come out in haste; this gathering is easy for Us.
We know well what they are saying (O Beloved), and you are not the one to force them at all, therefore advise with the Qur'aan the one who fears My threat.
